entities.summary: "Breathe" is a song by English DJ and record producer Jax Jones featuring vocals by Norwegian singer Ina Wroldsen and co-written by Fred Gibson. It was released on 1 December 2017 through Polydor Records. The song has peaked at number seven on the UK Singles Chart, number four in Ireland and number five in Scotland.
